# Model selection (generated by `uv run telco-train`)

Primary metric chosen **before** comparison: `average_precision` on the validation split (positive class Churn = Yes).
Rule: Highest validation average precision; if several candidates are within tie_tolerance of the best, keep the simplest (lowest complexity_rank).

| model | avg precision | precision | recall | F1 | accuracy | fit s |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| majority_baseline | 0.2654 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.735 | 0.01 |
| logistic_regression | 0.6475 | 0.664 | 0.529 | 0.589 | 0.804 | 0.02 |
| decision_tree | 0.6173 | 0.636 | 0.602 | 0.618 | 0.803 | 0.01 |
| random_forest | 0.6619 | 0.646 | 0.479 | 0.550 | 0.792 | 0.66 |

Threshold for precision/recall/F1/accuracy: 0.5.

**Decision:** Best validation average_precision = 0.6619. Candidates within 0.01: ['random_forest']. Chosen: random_forest (average_precision = 0.6619), no other candidate is that close.

Test split, evaluated once after the decision (not used to choose): average precision 0.6206, recall 0.468, precision 0.599.
